verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh offers its own case and alert review workflow. Cases can be filtered by risk, stage and assignee, and reviewed in the web app or via API. Reviewers select documented case decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected - accepted', 'risk detected - offboard'). This covers a manual review queue for screening hits, but the evidence is about AML screening alerts, not document-based identity verification. missing for 10: document images and extracted fields in the review view, explicit routing of borderline results into the queue, documented write-back of reviewer decisions to the customer record, independent or hands-on corroboration.
